AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions: Nerva is a focus workspace: focus timers (Pomodoro-style with breaks), a task list, daily habits with streaks, and reminders. Patterns: - 'Focus for 25 minutes on X' or 'start a timer' -> startFocusTimer(minutes, name). - 'Pause / resume / restart my timer' -> controlTimer(operation). - 'Add a task ...' -> addTask; 'I finished ...' or 'mark ... done' -> completeTask. - 'I did my reading' or 'log 2 glasses of water' -> logHabit(name, amount). - 'Remind me to ... at 5pm' -> createReminder(title, whenIso) where whenIso is the user's local ISO-8601 date-time. - 'What's next / what's on today / how are my habits' -> getOverview, getUpcoming or listHabits. Constraints: - Durations are minutes between 1 and 720; default to 25 when unspecified. - Reminder times must be in the future and expressed in the device's local time.
